relations.purpose_independence_test: Whether two cross-system identifiers denote the same legal counterparty is a factual identity question independent of which diligence purpose asked.

relations.name: contract_lifecycle_judgment
relations.reason: C2/C3 bounded semantic judgment with explicit grounding; proposition remains meaningful if purposes A/B/C disappear.

relations.name: clause_kind_judgment
relations.reason: Classification or assessment is defined relative to purpose-specific policies or decision thresholds; not promoted to World IR.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Classification depends on acquisition-exposure and commercial-dependency policies tied to purposes A and C; without those questions the clause-kind label has no independent truth conditions.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.reason: C4 deterministic derivation over admitted World relations; outputs are reusable facts independent of purpose framing.
relations.purpose_independence_test: Open billing status is a mechanical fact over invoice_record; it does not depend on any analytical purpose.

relations.name: reconciliation_link

relations.name: commercial_dependency_assessment

relations.name: contractual_exposure_invoice
relations.reason: Classification or assessment is defined relative to purpose-specific policies or decision thresholds; not promoted to World IR.
